title: SQL Service State
description: A board's own SQL database. Tables, columns and meaning all belong to the board. (Runtimes: node, browser; IDs: sql)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

emit.description: "result" passes the answer on, "input" passes the request through

database.description: Which database; services naming the same one share its tables. Empty: derived from the board's title (hkp-node), default (browser). Ignored by databases

statement.description: The SQL to run (query, run, exec)

schema.description: CREATE TABLE … applied once per board

lastCount.description: Read-only: rows returned, or rows changed

error.description: Read-only: why the last pass produced nothing
